mentions.name: htmlsync.io
mentions.description: This tool synchronizes localStorage between devices, letting users access data from single-file HTML web apps (often AI-generated apps that save data in localStorage) from another device such as a phone.
mentions.problem: Single-file HTML web apps that save data in localStorage keep that data confined to one device; the builder wanted access to it from a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on htmlsync.io, an easy way to synchronize localStorage between devices. I found myself using AI a lot to generate single-file HTML web apps that saved data in localStorage and wanted to have access to them from phone. This was my solution.
